svg.title: iOS: total row-render time per replay (ms, lower is better)
svg.text: iOS: total row-render time per replay (ms, lower is better)
iOS 18.6 simulator, development build, cold start, 2026-10-17. 5 runs per mode, up to 4 groups.
Total row-render time. Bars past 2,000 ms are clipped; the label is the real total. Green ⬆ better, red ⬇ worse.
Four isolated benchmark simulators; actual overlap varies. No physical iPhone performance claim.
